info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-Create Careers Applications Offer-v1-spec
info.description: The Careers Application Offer API facilitates the submission of job offers to candidates who have applied for positions within an organization. This endpoint allows users to create and manage offers efficiently, enabling HR and recruitment teams to streamline their hiring process. Typically utilized by recruitment software and HR platforms, this API supports use cases such as delivering offer letters and tracking the status of applications. By integrating this API, organizations can enhance their candidate experience and improve their overall recruitment workflow.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new offer for an application. Ensure that all required fields are filled correctly to avoid errors in processing the request.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit an offer application. It should contain all the necessary data required for processing the offer, including personal and application details. Ensure the information is formatted according to the specified schema.
